name: Paula R.
text:
It was a very intense challenging experience yet beautiful at the same time but I found it so worthwhile and beneficial I would recommend it to anyone a truly unique experience
Thankyou

name: Benedetta V.
text: Not only a perfectly organised retreat and well-curated experience, but also one of the most enriching gift that you could give to yourself! Thank you Dimtry and Karen - you have nurtured us all greatly!

name: Gerry H.
text: Hi, I didn’t know how I would find this experience and had a little bit of trepidation about it. My concerns quickly dissolved as the manner in which this is set out brought me a sense of comfort and trust in the people and the experience as it unfolded. Best money I have ever spent. I am now of the view that everyone should do this or something like it at least once - please do.

name: Alison S.
text:
Amazing, life changing. Can't say enough positive things about this Vipassana retreat.
Wonderful people, stunning place, gorgeous food, tranquility of mind while being totally at one with nature.
The teacher is concise and thoroughly captivating throughout, making the lessons and readings a pleasure to hear.
The mouth watering Ayurvedic food is made with extensive thought and great love.
My third visit has proved to be just as amazing, I would recommend to anyone wanting to find the peace and harmony of a still mind, surrounded by
 supportive like minded people.

name: Claire L.
text:
I had an amazing experience!!  It was wonderful to have a week away from everyday life to go within through meditation and enjoy the peace and beauty of living within an Eco community in Hardwicke Estate.  

I enjoyed sharing the week with such lovely people.   Even in the silence there was a feeling of connection. The teaching was very clear and carefully given. The glamping tent was very comfortable and the food was amazing.  

I highly recommend the experience.

name: John M.
text: The retreat was challenging, profound and meaningful. Dmitry is an excellent teacher and it is clear that he lives what he teaches. The authenticity is obvious. Karen’s organisation was faultless and the meals were delicious. Also the retreat team were always helpful and made the environment feel welcoming. I left a changed person and felt a strong connection with the other participants.

name: Isabella H.
text: Wasn't sure I could manage seven days of silence and meditation but the retreat is done in a way that it never felt too much. There's time to swim, use the sauna, have a massage and rest each day so the meditation feels much more manageable. The teachings are full of humour, which I much appreciated. Food was delicious. Can't fault it

name: Charlie H.
text: What a wonderful and well-balanced retreat with Sadhama. Camping by the river, sauna, daily swimming,  I felt wholly rejuvenated and reminded that Iosing touch with nature is the same as losing touch with myself. This became quietly but powerfully clear over the weekend. There’s just enough group yoga and meditation to offset the silence, and some, but not too much, explanatory talks on Buddhist ideas to provide context. For the seasoned yogi or meditator this might feel unnecessary. But even if it’s a beginners retreat (with fabulous vegan food three times a day) there’s enough space within it to make it your own. It was a great experience.

name: Robyn K.
text:
I had done the 7 day Vipassana retreat at Sadahma in July, but needed a shorter reset due to work commitments.  This was ideal.  
A perfect space of quiet and tranquility with time inbetween to rest and reset before the beginning of a busy term.  The food was out of this world - Karen and her team take such care with each meal and you can literally "taste" the love!  A must for anyone new to meditation and wanting to delve into the world of mindfullness.

name: Mary L.
text: From start to finish this was an absolutely amazing experience. Communication prior to the retreat was clear, friendly and informative and helped to set the tone for the retreat. I have practiced yoga for many years, and meditation more recently in the last couple of years, so it was great to have a weekend to be fully immersed and focused on developing my practice. The silent aspect really supported me to concentrate on being present with each part of the retreat. The setting was truly beautiful and it was lovely to have the opportunity to be in nature and spend time swimming in the river, walking in the forest and switching off from the busy hustle and bustle of my 'normal' life in London. The food was delicious, full of flavour, texture and vitality (thank you Karen and the kitchen team), and I have tried to maintain vegan, whole food eating since leaving the retreat as my body felt so much better for it! The yoga and meditation sessions led by Chiara and Dmitri were fantastic, very clear guidance and I felt very supported in each of their sessions. I also booked additional massage sessions - Thai yoga from Bara and lomi lomi from Greta. Both therapists were brilliant, especially at maintaining the noble silence and in their treatment. The only improvement that I could suggest would be having a campfire in the evenings, I'm presuming this wasn't possible during this weekend due to the recent dry weather/risk of wildfire. Thank you so much to all the organisers and the team that ran the weekend, it was clear to see all the love and commitment that went into every moment.

name: Timothy F.
text: It was a fantastic experience. Difficult first 24 hours  , but soon settled and had a great time in my own thoughts .the Food was exceptional , and the guided meditation was fantastic. 🙏🏻💙

name: James L.
text: Live simple to simple live - Rewind your self - I had a truly fantastic time. It's held in a really beautiful place, with amazing sunsets shining through the tent as you meditate. For a silent retreat the people were absolutely amazing it is crazy how you got to know people with their gentle presence and not a word spoken till the end. The practise was fantastic deep and energising both sitting meditation and yoga. The food was out of this world and alone worth the retreat for healing as you eat. It's absolutely what I needed as the seasons change from summer to autumn, chance to reflect and reenergise. One of the best retreats that I have had a chance to go on, and the wild swimming in the Thames every morning was a fantastic and refreshing start to the day.  will be definitely going back next year.

name: Richard S.
text: I had the pleasure of attending their 7 day silent Vipassana retreat recently and it was an utterly incredible experience. I spent the whole weak in tranquil peace, the silence and lack of tech was easy to adapt to and a pleasure to experience, and the bond you create with others even without engaging with them was truly special. I'd never understood the concept of connecting with nature until then, but you end up plugging into all of the sounds of the animals and flow of the land around you which was a very unique experience. No need to have done anything similar before, there were folk from all different ages and backgrounds, but do be ready to have a life changing experience! Thanks to all the team who were the best.

name: Ms A.
text: Amazing experience, now on my 2nd year. Karen and Dimitry and team are so generous, the setting is just beautiful, food is so tasty and wholesome. "What the world needs now". Thank you.

name: Julie P.
text: Vipassana retreat is no vacation. It’s a hard cycle of daily routine lasting a full  5 days. With an intro evening and closing morning wrapped around. Dimitry is a learned teacher of Dharma and yoga. The experience left me balanced calmer centred and focused on living an improved nourishing morally enhanced life. Having started living a Buddhist life it was appropriate to take this ancient form of retreat. The hospitality was perfect. All needs to get through the silence and meditation are taken care of. I pitched my tent this year, the nights were cold but the purpose was to recognise the impermanence of all things. For the days were sunny and warm. A perfect location was set at Hardwick estate. Tranquil countryside which nestles against the river Thames. Whilst writing this a few days from returning home. I feel blessed to have found Sadhama. The locally sourced food was magically cooked with love and care by Karen the host. Every meal fulfilled my daily needs for nutritional sustenance. You are submersed into mindfulness no need to worry about anything, let go of all the world outside. I wish to thank Dimitry, Karen, the crew and all my fellow Watchers. See you somewhere again on our journeys. X

name: Lucy P.
text: A place of purity. Karen and Dmitry have crafted a magical experience at Hardwick estate. Every retreat is soaked in wisdom and love, from the Natural flow to the Vipassana. Whatever your style, you’ll walk away enriched with a new breath for life.

name: Ann H.
text:
I had a wonderful time at the Sadhama ReWild Silent Retreat at Hardwick Estate. A truly beautiful experience in magnificent countryside, with the peace and stillness of silence, wonderful walks, wild swimming and the sauna.
A special mention has to go to Karen’s exceptional cooking — every meal was absolutely delicious, nourishing and made with so much care. Dmitry's teaching and meditations were profound and lasting.
A really special few days to slow down, reconnect with nature and simply be. Highly recommended.

name: Karen S.
text: It may have only been 3 nights away but I feel the teachings will stay with me for a lifetime. Impeccably run retreat. I learnt so much in a simple, practical and humourous way. Wonderful nature, fabulous yoga topped off with delicious and bountiful vegan food. I left feeling deep gratitude for everyone involved 🙏

name: Tracy E.
text:
This 3 night silent retreat was just perfect. The combination of river swimming, kundalini and yin yoga, forest walk,  dhamma teaching and meditation along with delicious nourishing food in such beautiful surroundings was both restful and recharging, and a great opportunity for a digital reset after 4 phone free days. 
Dimitri is an excellent teacher, knowledgeable and funny, and Karen is the heart of the place and a culinary genius. I wish I could have stayed longer

name: Christine E.
text: An amazing experience in every way. Life changing.

name: Louise H.
text:
This was one of the highlights of my life. The location on the Thames is: camping field, activity tent, outdoor showers, lovely compost loos and a camp kitchen, it was serene, well kept, and lovingly prepared for us. The food was divine and felt like yoga for the digestive system. The activities were expertly delivered, with a sparling kindness and humour. This place is low key, as it's all about integrity and intention and the content is coherent with their aims.
I went on the 4 day silent retreat (Practice of Peace) my first foray into serious meditation and noble silence. I found the mix of structured activities like swimming, yoga, darma talks, and guided meditation meant that I was able to be guided along this journey at my pace and without expectations or judgement. I found the silence was quite freeing and doing it as a group made it a meaningful journey that we passed together. It was a slow burn, it was incredible in a very understated way. I think I have learnt some valuable life lessons and I have been told I have a new calmness and lightness since returning. I thought it was incredible value for money, as we had many structured sessions with very experienced teachers. To say I loved it would be an understatement. Thank you to Karen, Dimitri, the team of volunteers, the organic Veganic growers and to the other participants ❤️🌞🙏

name: Eva R.
text:
Thank you so much for a beautiful retreat.
It was a shorter stay, but still very high standards- welcoming and calm organisers/ tutors and fantastic food made by alchemist/ healer.
It was so peaceful to be back with nature.
Following your instruction to be present, I applied it while swimming in the river. Early morning two kingfishers flew by on their breakfast hunt. Later a swan pair was feeding just 7 meters away, and at lunch a couple of wild ducks swam past. I stayed still, gave them space, and felt so privileged and in peace.
The walk in forest, showing respect and sharing the energy with the trees, and finishing with a mesmerising view over the valley revelling under sunshine after short rain.
Thank you for holding such a safe, calm and respectful space- where nature is real. I will be back.
With gratitude
Ev

Please feel free to share anonymously

name: Cameron P.
text:
An incredible and genuinely transformative experience. The retreat was beautifully organised, with the perfect balance of meditation, yoga, teachings, reflection, nature, cold water and sauna.
It was challenging at times, especially being completely offline and silent, but that was exactly what made it so powerful. I left feeling calmer, clearer and far more present.
The team created a warm, safe and thoughtful environment throughout. A very special experience that I would highly recommend.

name: Eleanor H.
text: Amazing experience! I feel like I've found myself again. The food was delicious, the setting gorgeous, amazing meditations and yoga. And such a relief not having to talk to people but still being with them.

name: Carl H.
text: We had no expectations of this retreat, never having done anything like it before. It turned out to be an incredible experience for both of us., reaching deeper levels than ever before. The connection with the people and nature was real - beautiful location, amazing food, nourishment for the soul through yoga, meditation and music. We will be back!

name: Lorraine F.
text:
A friend and myself went to Hardwick house for a rest and restore day.
It was amazing,  very different and a great way to switch off for a few hours and enjoy peace and quiet in a beautiful setting.
Dimitri was very knowledgeable. 
After a walk to a forest clearing and a meditation we enjoyed a sauna amongst the trees and a swim in the river Thames.
To end we gathered around the table back at Hardwick house for a wonderful 2 course vegan meal made by Karen (Dimitri's wife) it was amazing. 
Already looking to visit again.

name: Caroline W.
text:
This was my second vipassana retreat with this company and I’m happy to say that it was another powerful learning experience. I am keen to develop my meditation practice and this retreat definitely delivered! The team are lovely and cannot do enough for you. 

Add ons like Thai massage, Reiki and Kinesiology were most welcome. The therapists (there are more) are all beautiful people so if you’re thinking of booking please consider booking in when you arrive! I felt at peace and welcomed the opportunity to sit and walk in silence (I was even joined by a butterfly at one point). Being on the Thames, meditation overlooking a meadow, delicious food, yoga every morning with Bara … just what I needed. A taste of blissful contentment. An escape from my busy home and work life.  Wholehearted thank you and much love to my fellow meditators and the Sadhama team.

name: Estela S.
text: I had a beautiful experience at an Insight Vipassana Silent Meditation Retreat. It truly changed my inner perspective. Even as a beginner in meditation, the guidance, kindness, and support I received throughout the retreat helped me feel grounded and never lost. It was a deeply transformative experience, and I am very grateful for everything I learned there.

name: Elise S.
text: A really beautiful and grounding experience. The peace of being without a phone was amazing and gave me a proper reset. The food was incredible, and all the teachers and staff were so kind and supportive. It was challenging at first but ended up being really calming and restorative.

name: Will D.
text:
Wow. What a fantastic retreat. So much appreciation for Dimitri, Karen, Sam and the team. Having been on vipassna before in a different setting, I felt worried at first due to my previously "isolating" or "difficult" experience with silence and extended periods of meditation. But the way the space of the retreat was held, with compassion and care, left no room for these negative feelings or experiences.

Dimitris dharmic teachings were fantastic, well illustrated and his sense of humour and wisdom really shines through. Karen's food is delightful, and I really felt comfortable asking her for anything. 

The environment of the retreat itself is breathtaking. Such a bizarre non hostile bit of campsite, a few biting insects, but the fact we walked around barefoot for most of the week was testement to this. The sauna was perhaps the nicest looking horsebox sauna I've been in and lovely and hot. Being able to dip in the river after was equally excellent.

The massage I got from the therapists was brilliant also, perhaps my favourite of the year.

Essentially, brilliant. Will be back, loved it.

With metta,

Will

name: Robyn K.
text: A ultra marathon of the mind and body!  But well worth it.  A perfect and beautiful setting of green fields and hills nestled in a valley next to the Thames filled with bird life.  Dmitry was an interesting and amusing teacher and his team of helpers held the group together with grace, kindness and ease.  I would encourage anyone who would like to jolt themselves out of the mundane and reset to join this retreat.

name: April D.
text:
I've been on many retreats over the years and had been searching for the right Vipassana retreat for the last three years. When I came across this one back in January, something instantly drew me to it. What an incredibly profound and expansive experience. It has undoubtedly changed the way I view the world, deepened my connection with all beings and the natural world, and strengthened my meditation practice. Throughout the retreat, I felt deeply held, supported, and safe. The team struck the perfect balance of care, creating an environment where I felt genuinely looked after while allowing space for my own process to unfold. The teachings, community, therapists, and sattvic food were all exceptional. I've learnt so much, both in deepening my understanding of Buddhism and in supporting my path of meditation and self-inquiry. I feel incredibly fortunate to be returning in September. Thank you to the whole team for your genuine love and dedication to what you do, and for making Vipassana so accessible.
Sending love,
April x

name: Tony P.
text: This is a profound experience.  It should be very beneficial, but you will have to do some work.  They made a path but you have to walk it.  If you like a challenge and have some time... it is a fantastic opportunity.  Read the instructions!  Breathe and enjoy! Thank you all.

name: Tiluka B.
text:
The most beautiful retreat! Everything was beyond perfect - THE FOOD, the talks, the company Really grateful for the spaces you create, I loved the silence and my only suggestion would be to create a 10 day vipassana!!!!! 
I love how organised everything is and how hygienic eveything felt.
Dmitry is a wonderful teacher and you are a wonderful pair ❤️ thank you, I’ll be back!

name: Harvey F.
retreat: Sweat and Serenity - Deep Cleansing Retreat 2026
text:
This weekend is all about experiencing a Sweat lodge which takes up almost a whole day.  It is quite and experience and very well led by Andy who makes you feel very welcome, supported and confident that he knows what he is doing - which he does - he was brilliant actually and has a very extensive background of involvement with North American Indian tribes in which this ceremony is routed.  It is a really authentic experience and is quite a remarkable one.  I felt both challenged and changed by it.  You have to do it to understand what that means!

Anyway, swimming in the Thames was beautiful and the sauna on the banks is very welcome after a swim which wasn't really that chilly when we were there.  

The food is out of this world. Karen is a very talented chef and creates fantastic meals - orange cauliflower was my favorite, but every plate a had a myriad of flavors and textures - so yummy and filling.   All vegetarian and inspiring.

The Yoga classes were very well taught, outside in an open sided "marguee" type of tent which will be fine in most weather.  It overlooked a field of buttercups and long grass and had large insects flying straight up and down in the sunlight. Very beautiful - they weren't interested in us, and I wasn't bitten the whole weekend.  There was A LOT of bird song at dawn and whilst doing Yoga - beautiful.

There were many people who had come alone, including myself, and it was great to get to know many of them.  The workshops and lecture gave an opportunity to talk openly about our lives and to share some significant experiences that we had had.

We were blessed with some great musicians there and we had fun singing some difficult songs in harmony - only possible because the leader was so good.  Dimitri is very interesting and knowledgeable about meditation and other spiritual matters and held his sessions well.  I felt that he and Karen really were on a mission to help people grow and that it wasn't just about making a living for them.  Their commitment to providing an excellent event attracts many volunteers who help the weekend pass smoothly.  Nice people as well.

The tented accommodation was as good as it could be, and I didn't mind the rather basic composting toilet and showers - I didn't feel the need to use the permanent ones in the buildings.

I had a Thai massage - fully clothed - from Barra who was excellent and really help my tired legs from cycling there (100km!) in the heat.  Other therapies were available which other also enjoyed.  Some saying they really helped them come to terms with difficult situations in their lives.

So all in all a great weekend, well worth the money and I knew I would want to come to the Hardwick Estate again after the very first mouthful of Karen's food!

I forgot to mention the tree bathing - such a relaxing time in the nearby wood/forest.  I have never felt so at peace.

I will go next year,

All the best to anyone who knows me who reads this!

Harvey

name: Trish D.
retreat: Sweat and Serenity - Deep Cleansing Retreat 2026
text:
Mud, water, heat, healing, silence, laughter and a little bit of glorious emotional unraveling — and that was only the sweat lodge.

A weekend of serenity indeed. Forest bathing beneath cathedral trees, cold water courage, bare feet on damp earth and the Thames practically lapping at my ginger fingertips.

I arrived carrying the noise of life and left feeling crusty, windswept, soothed and somehow stitched back together again.

The food? Exquisite. Nourishment in every sense of the word.
The people? Kind, open, beautifully human.
The experience? Deeply grounding and quietly transformational.

There is something about sweat, mud and river water that reminds you who you are underneath all the layers.

I will absolutely be back. 🌿🔥💧

name: Jennifer H.
text:
A peaceful rural location, amazing food and outdoor sauna a really special experience.  The yoga session was quite "strong" - think I was expecting more gentle but I did enjoy it. Would have been lovely to have a meditation included too. 
Met some very nice people too.

name: Tina B.
text:
One of the most profound times of my life, and I’m quite old 🫣😂. 
Dmitry, Karen and their team have created a beautifully immersive experience where you literally do not need to think, about anything (as per the goal of the retreat). 
The meditation was full on, but broken up into sitting and walking; the talks from Dmitry were very insightful, he is a very wise and memorising teacher 🙏, the Ayurvedic food from Karen was nourishing and delicious; and an incredible early morning yoga practice was placed into the timetable too, to support our bodies for the sitting meditations. 
Sharing this experience with 50 strangers, created a very safe space and deep connection.  
Stunning natural location, just a totally beautiful experience 🙏

name: Simon T.
text:
I would describe my experience as PERFECT!!!!!! Seriously! 
If you are looking to 'sort your sh1t out', then you need look no further.
The team created the perfect setting to get you on the path and support you as you travelled along it.
Utterly sublimely organised from the delicious food to the utterly beautiful location.
I wanted a river and lots of greenery. This retreat delivered in that in abundance. On the banks of the River Thames surrounded by 200 year old oak trees and fields that stretch to the rolling green hills in the distance. Nature gently holds you as you are guided through your practice. Bliss.
Expert guidance carried me through as I worked hard on my practice. I felt hugely supported, even through the silence. The power and love I felt emanating from the group was immense. Wow! Wow! Wow! I wouldn't change a thing. 
Didn't miss my phone one bit. So glad to have a break from the craziness of the modern life. 
Don't let the early starts put you off. It turns out they are exactly what you need! You go to bed early anyway and awake energised, ready to mediate some more. 

Stop reading this now and get yourself booked. I promise you will not regret this opportunity to grow.
Written with the deepest of love.

I'm in! Vipassana all the way! I'm already booked in for another trip!
Good luck legend! You're doing better than you think!

name: Karin T.
text: Ah..what a magical week! Thank you again to the team for organising and supporting all participants as needed! One of the most beautiful & transformative experiences in my life! The whole team was caring and amazing at creating a safe space for our journey which helped us to really deepen our practice. Dmitry's teaching is astonishing! If you want to experience the real deal (truly lucky to receive teachings/Dharma talks in english), meet like minded beautiful people, be surrounded by nature, love, inspiration and spiritual drive 1000% this is the right place to do it at! I will definitely be back xx

name: Claire L.
text:
Words can’t describe the experience I had at the Vipassana Retreat, but I’ll give it a go. From the moment I arrived to the time I left, it was just beautiful! Everything was very well organised and I instantly felt at home. 

The setting is just stunning, rolling hills with ever changing light, sculptural ancient oaks and the glistening River Thames. As a photographer it was difficult for me to not capture this magical light through the lens. This was actually one of the reasons I came here (as well as finding inner peace), to detach from my phone (taking photos and social media). It was a real weight off my shoulders when I handed my phone in. I quickly learnt to see through my eyes rather than through the lens. Eventually seeing through closed eyes whilst meditating. 

The location is a feast for the senses. Seeing the beautiful environment cocooning you, with that ethereal starry night sky and full moon. Hearing all the wonderful wildlife, the geese, red kites, owls, sheep, cows, horses. I even miss the sound of the comforting wake up gong. Smelling the burning wood when the sauna is almost ready. The wind blowing around you, aiding in meditation. The sun kissing your face, the cooling river on an afternoon dip, followed by the welcoming toasty sauna. Tasting the delicious, nutritious, thoughtful food cooked up by Karen. The tasty evening drink was something else.

I soon adapted to waking up and falling asleep with the sun, to nature’s natural rhythm. It almost became easy rising at 4.30am because I knew everyone else would be there meditating with me. I found the energy from the group really spurred me on to finish. We were such a strong willed, caring group. I made friends for life with a connection unlike any other. It was lovely to connect with everyone on the first afternoon, then move into noble silence. Connecting once again with them at the end of the retreat once the noble silence was lifted, sharing all our wonderful experiences.

I found inner peace like never before from this Vipassana Retreat. When you find that tranquility, nothing else matters but that moment, being present. The hours and days I spent meditating bloomed into the most beautiful flower. Push through and you will find that inner peace and serenity. Don’t give up! After years of meditating I thought I knew the practice, it turns out I didn’t, but now I do. Thank you. 

Dmitry is the perfect teacher, so calm and knowledgeable. Merging words of wisdom with a bit of humour, which we all really appreciated in our hours of silence. Karen is great, with her organisational skills behind the scenes and being a fantastic cook. David was our gong master, gently waking us from our deep sleep. Bara was invaluable with her morning yoga sessions that got us through the aches and pains from sitting for so long. All the staff and therapists were all so friendly, much needed and did a great job. 

Here I am writing this on day 5 after leaving the retreat and my shoulders are still relaxed and down, usually they’re always tense and up. I’m going about everything in a slower, calmer manner. I have more patience and am more giving. I’m still keeping up my daily meditation, I find this is very important once you leave the retreat. 

Thank you Dmitry, Karen and the team for everything. I will be back!

name: Eva R.
text: I had a great experience. Wonderful people, delicious food produced by alchemist:) Peaceful environment with perfect neighbours🪿🦉🦢 🐑… Thank you 🙏

name: Ms A.
text: Where do I start, I booked for a rather random reason. Quite a life changing experience - the chatter in your brain starts to calm, the beautiful natural world in which the retreat is located comes much more into focus and you start to feel the joy which is what life should be about - I was quite euphoric when I got home. On a practical level food was so so tasty, the meditations were uplifting and often surreal, the instruction really thought provoking. Yoga and therapy just made it even more amazing! Just thank you. X

name: Victoria S.
text: Absolutely fantastic, I can highly recommend. The best investment in myself, truly excellent value with a packed itinerary of brilliant activities including yoga, led meditation, breathing work, sound bath...the list goes on!

name: Sam S.
text: If you are looking for a peaceful heart led retreat with the right pace of activity, beautifully led meditations and yoga in riverside setting this is perfect

name: Corinne C.
text:
I had an amazing time at the retreat.
So much good is coming out of it.
I felt very welcomed. The kindness of the host was amazing feeling. I felt safe there.
The food was different but lovely.
And the place is beautiful. 
Highly recommend thank you

name: Eulalie O.
text: Great program, great people, one is a life time experience x

name: Sahra W.
text: I gained so much from this experience. I am now doing daily meditation and trying to fit yoga in when I can as a result. It has helped me to let go and make peace with a lot of things. Everybody was so lovely and it felt like such a safe space even though we couldn't talk all week. I would recommend it to anyone.

name: Rael T.
text:
When I signed up for this, I didn't look into what the itinerary was. If I did, I might not have gone through with it. I am glad I didn't, as I had a truly transformational experience and was very proud that I completed the retreat. The location was idyllic, the teachers were very clear and fun to listen to, and the food was delicious (and that is coming from a true meat-eater). I've only been back 4 days and I have more energy, focus, concentration, and I'm overall more joyful, which is something I've struggled with for decades.
I have not stopped talking about this since I returned, and I will be looking to do another one next year.
Thank you, Dimitri and Karen.

name: Jim D.
text: I attended the Midwinter Wellbeing retreat at the grand Hardwick House that focussed on meditation. It was a great 5 hour mini-break on a bleak, rainy November evening.  As with other retreats, the  mediatation instruction offered by Dmitry was insightful and resulted in a deep mediation experience. The vegertarian cooking by Karen lived up to its  normal extremely high standards, made from locally grown organic vegatables wirth tasty sauces and a wonderful dessert. There were a wide range of participants in terms of age and gender, making for relaxed, but stimulating converstation. Highly recommended as a winter getaway!

name: Elena G.
text: It was an amazing experience. Relaxing atmosphere to meditate, wonderful group of people, delicious food and drinks and a lovely sauna. Would love to do it again and definitely recommend it!

name: Daniel A.
text:
I really can't recommend these guys highly enough. It clearly takes a great depth of skill, passion, commitment and integrity to run a Vipassana retreat and Dmitry and his team had all of those and then some. The setting is stunning and so supportive to the work being done. The food was a dream, aesthetically the structures were beautiful and felt just right for the work being done. 

Most of all, Dmitry is a brilliant communicator, able to make everyone laugh and to push on in cold weather, and to pay close attention and offer incisive, precise and compassionate guidance when required, which allowed me to go deeper into the practice than I could have imagined. I've worked with many teachers in many fields and Dmitri is right up at the top. 

Go for it.

name: Rachel B.
text: The Harwick Estate is a magical place and Dmitry & Karen dedicated to helping, healing and sharing their gifts with the world.  Vipassana is a challenging undertaking but under Dmitry's kind, humorous and humble guidance, one can find their way back to their true selves.  Karen and her team work quietly and attentively in the background, making sure that every is cared for and has all that they need.  The food was another level!  If you are looking for a genuine place to connect to yourself and your heart under the care of those who only have your best interests at heart, this is it.

name: Dawid K.
text:
I reached the point where too many life difficulties and challenges started piling up, there was too much stress and anxiety I couldn't bear it any longer.
A retreat can give you the time you really need to disconnect from everyday life and see everything from a different perspective.
After the retreat positive events started to unfold in my life, everything started to "click" perfectly into place. I started regular mediation practice, my marriage got back on tracks, my family relationship and work improved.
I can't prise the retreat and organisers enough, attending the event was a life changing experience. Dmitri, Karen and a team are really passionate about what they do and you can feel their love every single day of a retreat and I am so grateful for meeting them all and attending retreat.

name: Anil D.
text: Had a fantastic time on an incredibly rewarding retreat.

name: Sharon P.
text: Had a challenging but wonderful time on this vipassana. Had never done one before and it was amazing to give myself so much “space” while being nurtured by the wonderful food and staff 🙏 thank you all so much ❤️

name: Dionne S.
text:
I recently attended an incredible silent Vipassana retreat nestled in a serene woodland setting, and it exceeded all my expectations. The natural beauty of the surroundings provided the perfect backdrop for deep meditation and self-reflection. The silence allowed for a deep immersion into the practice, fostering an environment of profound inner peace and clarity.
The teachings were transformative, delivered by Dmitry who guided us with wisdom and compassion. The daily schedule was well-balanced.

The food, prepared by Karen with her crew – was simply amazing. Every meal was thoughtfully prepared, nourishing, and delicious, with an array of fresh, wholesome ingredients. Yum

The sense of community among fellow participants, even in silence, was heartwarming and supportive.

Overall, this silent Vipassana retreat was a truly transformative experience, offering profound insights, inner peace, and a renewed sense of clarity. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a meaningful and rejuvenating retreat in a beautiful natural setting.

Thank you to all, I cannot wait to return x

name: Lisa R.
text: A Challenging week that was well worth the effort.  This gave me a much deeper understanding of meditation with great guidance from Dimitry and amazing food prepared by Karan.  The whole week was really well organised and the sauna and open swimming made the whole experience very special.  Anyone looking to do their first silent retreat, this is a great start.

name: Anna L.
text: This was one of the most LIFE CHANGING experiences ever. Dmitry is such an incredible knowledgable and humble teacher. He really embodies the practices and is able to tailor the approach to suit each unique persons needs. Karen is the most amazing chef and the food was out of this world delicious. I can't wait for the next one and would recommend EVERYONE to join multiple retreats with Sadhama. It's rare to find down to earth teachers in the "spiritual world" but Sadhama are both down to earth and authentic. Thank you!

name: Michael P.
text: This was an amazing experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone, but be warned, its tough.

name: Corinne S.
text:
It was a lovely mini retreat for myself, immersed outside all day with interesting talks/workshops by experts in their field & interacting with likeminded individuals or just being by myself in nature & feeling nourished by delicious, mindfully cooked  food. 
Thank you!

name: Rosalind S.
text: I attended the &Beyond retreat last September and had been dreaming all winter of going back to the Hardwick Estate. When the Trees of Life retreat popped into my email , I signed up straight away . I love all the elements that Dimitry and Karen put together in this beautiful place. The food is amazing, made with such care and love. The yoga and meditations , the trees and the music. They really create a magical event in a magical space. I highly recommend if you want to nourish your body, mind and soul.

name: Farida S.
text: Wow, what a beautiful & nourishing experience for body, mind & soul! Such a wonderful team & community of people, and held in a stunning space which really enhanced the magic of the retreat.  I loved the incorporation & honouring of all the elements in the weekend - Earth via the delicious Ayurvedic food, tree meditation & acknowledgment the land, the ceremonial fires, fire jumping, walking  & dancing, wild swimming & stone river ritual and the air through beautiful songs, music & focus of breath during the yoga sessions. I came out of the weekend feeling so rejuvenated! Thank you all for making it so special!

name: Ratika P.
text: I had a superb five day experience. Food was absolutely delicious. The grounds were peaceful and serene by the river. Meditations, gong baths, morning swims were all conducted smoothly by all the teachers. LOVED EVERYTHING!

name: Tracey H.
text:
I had the most amazing weekend retreat 💚 this is the third Sadhama retreat I’ve been on and they just get better and more magical every time!  It came along at exactly the right moment for me. Even as I drove through the gates I felt excited and a sense of being home and so alive 💚

Felt so nurtured and nourished by the delicious Ayurvedic food prepared for us, the wonderful community of conscious beings, being completely immersed in nature outside the whole time. So special to swim in the Thames with geese flying low and the mist parting to allow the early morning sunlight through. The ritual before the swim was so beautiful Ayurvedic on Saturday and shamanic on Sunday. I was very emotional as I whispered everything I wanted to release into a pebble to take into the water with me.

Saturday evening was probably a highlight for me - ecstatic dancing around the fire followed by fire jumping and a fire walk. Felt so exhilarated to have gone outside my comfort zone. This was followed by the most beautiful gong bath essential to ground us after all the excitement. Lying under the stars on our yoga mats in our sleeping bags feeling as though I was sinking into the ground in a semi conscious state.

Really enjoyed the variety of yoga sessions especially liminal yoga with Brian who is so interesting to talk to and very generous with his time. All the crew were awesome, welcoming and very friendly.

Last but not least Dima’s tree meditation is beautiful. Each time I join him for a tree meditation I feel I am able to go deeper …

Thank you all so much 
So much love and gratitude 
I feel blessed to have found you 💗💕

name: Stephanie C.
text: Really enjoyed this weekend of peace, yoga, meditation, amazing food and wonderful company 😊

name: Ian P.
text:
I had an amazing life changing experience with people that I felt safe to be myself with. Really well organised with so many wonderful things to do.The food was out of this world if they had a restaurant I would move next door.
The yoga ,meditation,breath work ,and talks were first class.also some fantastic treatments.and some beautiful music and singing from top notch musicians. Book me up for next year please.

name: Louise S.
text: a beautiful experience.  amazing food. wonderful yoga, meditation, swimming, music and much more.  a truly wonderful and magical experience. highly recommend.

name: Antonia D.
retreat: Sweat and Serenity - Deep Cleansing Retreat 2021
text: Thank you for such a great fantastic experience! Perfect mind reset with yoga and meditation! ❤️

name: Chiara L.
retreat: Sweat and Serenity - Deep Cleansing Retreat 2021
text:
A truly transformative experience where i felt connected to nature and to all the lovely people around me. A chance to regain some peace and calm, and to tune in to my body. And the sun came out for us the whole weekend!! 
 My highlights:
1) the absolutely delicious food. I'm missing it already. Loved that it was tailored to my personal ayurvedic constitution, made with love, with great fresh ingredients and tasted divine. 
2) the people. The organisers crafted the programme with such thought, love and genuine care, and really did everything from the heart. Dima's deep meditations and early morning dips, Karen's creation of a truly communal meal-sharing experience (and tasty, tasty desserts!), Andy's humility and sense of humour while holding a profoundly transformative space for us in the sweat lodge,  Kitty's gorgeous voice, hilarious lyrics and friendly smiles, Bara's grounding, nurturing morning yoga, Brian's out-of-this-world sonic soundscape... they were all incredible and each wore their unique talents lightly.  A group of amazing volunteers helping everything run smoothly... and an eclectic collection of participants with whom i felt truly comfortable and relaxed. 
3) the setting. Unbelievable almost that we were so close to London- it felt worlds away. Lying on the grass, among the wild flowers (and particularly spectacular red clover), bathing in the river, staring at the stars, being hypnotized by the flames of the campfire. It felt AMAZING! 
Totally 100% recommended.

name: Sarah B.
retreat: Sweat and Serenity - Deep Cleansing Retreat 2021
text:
This four day retreat amidst the beautiful land of the Hardwick Estate was absolutely divine and I got everything and more that I had hoped for.
The team that organised and facilitated the four days, all their volunteer helpers made it so incredibly nurturing and special, so much care had obviously gone into the planning.
The food was cooked for us with such love and was sensational, there was always too much of it! 
Mornings offering early morning swims, yoga practice followed by either a sweat lodge, forest bath meditation in the stunning tree chapel or a two hour Oak tree meditation to follow was then on the cards... along with other workshops. The evening was spent around an open fire reading poetry, writings, singing or jamming before a quiet deep and soothing outdoor sleep.
For all those wanting to get away from the world as it is and step into harmony with the land and other like minded souls, for people wanting to challenge themselves a bit and face any emotions buried deeply that may arise after the deeply evocative process of a sweat lodge ceremony, for all those brave souls out there wanting to find some peace this is the retreat for you!
Thank you so much to all involved in the running of it. Will be back in September for the next.
So much love, Sarah

name: Kitty S.
text: What an absolutely beautiful and nourishing gathering this was. Words cannot even describe how it left me feeling... Kundalini yoga, tree meditations, forest bathing and wonderful aryuvedic meals alongside wild river swims and songs around the campfire. The weekend was very well organised, at a lovely chilled pace with a great range of workshops and time to sit and connect with lovely souls. Thank you Dima, Kary, and Karen for a much needed and very wholesome weekend. I would totally recommend it and can't wait for the next one!

name: Anil
text: A great experience with wonderful people

name: Jess G.
text:
This was the first type of retreat I'd done, so was looking for something within the UK, that wasn't too expensive, as I wasn't sure how I would find the experience. (Please note I only rated the accommodation as 'Good' because I took my own tent).

Getting rid of all the background noise (pun intended) and finding out what my inner voice was. This experience really stripped away all the distractions and the excuses and left me, with me. Since the retreat I've looked at my diet in a completely different way, I've stopped wearing my smart watch, I charge my phone away from my bedroom. This retreat was a real circuit breaker in terms of making lifestyle changes.

Listen to your yoga teacher if they tell you to ensure you're sat with your hips above your knees! - I remembered on day 5 and once I sat on my cushion on top of my yoga blocks my hips opened and it was a much (much) more comfortable meditation position.

Also, when in the meditation tent, it's expected that you're covered from shoulder to knee (this wasn't strictly adhered to, as it was> 30 degrees during the retreat I attended, but knowing would have meant I could have packed less stuff).

name: Anonymous guest
text:
I needed solitude from the rat race!

I wanted to unplug, slow down, and learn something new.

Being surrounded by nature was wonderful for nourishing the soul and reconnecting with myself.

name: Sarah
text:
I wanted to deepen and expand my meditation and yoga practice.

The course looked great, the location was perfect, and the group wasn’t too big.

name: Kirsten
text:
I was exhausted from work and needed a reset. Plus I had been meaning to do Vipassana for 25 years ....

I chose the retreat for the location; it's easy to get to, and it's a beautiful place! Karen's cooking is fabulous, Dimitri is wise and kind, and Govinda bangs the gong.

Noticing how much anxiety I hold and gaining techniques to release it.

You've got to do it, at least once in your life.

name: Nicola
text:
I wanted to have a complete circuit break from normal life, enjoy being in nature in silence with like minded people and develop my meditation practice.
I chose this program because I knew that the location, on the bank of a river surrounded by trees and a small farming cooperative would be beautiful and peaceful.  The host, Dimitry's, teachings were wise and compassionate and gave just the right amount of information to be helpful and relevant to every day life.
After spending a week here my mind and body feel calm and clear and I feel more confident and settled in daily life.
If you are after peace and serenity and are ready to commit to a monastic schedule (early rising and  going to bed with lots of meditation and silence in between) in the care of very compassionate people, I don't think you'll find a better retreat than this one.

name: Luke
text:
I wanted to get serious about my meditation practice
There was a clear focus on silent meditation, the location and structure of the retreat was exactly what I was looking for
From the clear and direct guidance I broke through into the first stage of Vipasana and it felt incredible. I now have experiential evidence that this technique works and I can maintain the practice myself. I brought back a new skill which will always be with me throughout my life
It's not for the faint of heart, it is very focused on meditation and silence. The location is beautiful and the staff are the nicest people you'll ever meet. The additional treatments are fantastic value for money and overall I cannot recommend it enough

name: Kelly
text:
The retreat was the perfect place to detox from life and find a better way going forward. Everything was wonderful from the beautiful river swims, sauna, teaching and delightful food. Couldn’t have asked for more from all the team! Thank you! 
As it was so different from what I’d seen before! I liked the silence! 
More relaxed, better able to deal with life’s stressors and happier!

name: Andrew
text: I didn’t realise how much I needed, the retreat gave me a full reset and first time I’ve ever done anything like it, everyone was fantastic with the teachings and the food was unreal, can’t wait to go back

name: Chrissy
text:
I was seeking to find the next path/direction in my journey of life.
I planned to go on the 7 day retreat but realised that I was not at that level. I am truly grateful I was able to change to the 4 days silent/peace retreat.   It was the best decision I could have made. An amazing experience.

The hosts and their program are very authentic, very sincere and true to their believes.
They really do live and breathe the life.

I feel I am able to really focus on changes I need to do in my life. I now have the self awareness and direction. 
Life gives us opportunities and choices for a reason. Take them and book a Retreat.

name: Carl M.
text:
Partner and I are meditators and yoga doers, wanted to share same and more with likeminded others. This retreat was unbelievably amazing in every way! Will be returning for certain.
I chose it for the diversity of activities, spiritual music, healthy living.
I reached deeper spiritual level than ever before. Felt deeply connected to nature and everyone there.
Be good if BookRetreats didn’t send so may annoying emails 😁

name: Andrew
text:
I hoped to push through and detach from difficult feelings and feel more compassion in the current moment.

Clearly explained details emailed at time required.Great service at a low price retreat.

name: Lisa D.
text:
I have a long-standing appreciation for Vipassana meditation and have benefited greatly from previous donation-based courses. I wanted to deepen my understanding by experiencing the teaching from a different teacher and perspective. The donation-based approach aligns with my values, and I was interested in learning from Dimitry, whose teaching I found every bit as insightful and valuable as my previous experiences.

I chose this course because it aligned with values that are important to me. I have attended several donation-based Vipassana courses over the years and have always appreciated the spirit in which the teachings are offered. The teacher training provided an opportunity to deepen my understanding of a practice that has been meaningful in my own life. The fact that the course was held in the UK was also a significant factor. It meant I could travel there easily and stay in my own van, which added a sense of comfort and independence to the experience. What I liked most about the programme was its authenticity. It felt grounded, accessible and sincere, with an emphasis on personal experience and practical learning. The quality of the teaching was excellent, the food was outstanding, and being able to swim in the river was a wonderful bonus. Together, these elements created a supportive environment that felt both nourishing and conducive to learning.

As I completed the course only four days ago, I feel it is still too early to fully assess its longer-term impact. However, I left with a deeper appreciation of the practice, valuable insights into teaching, and a renewed commitment to my own meditation journey. I expect my understanding and integration of the learning to continue unfolding over the coming weeks and months.

If you are looking for an authentic, donation-based meditation retreat with high-quality teaching, a supportive atmosphere, and excellent facilities, I would highly recommend this course. The setting was beautiful, the food was outstanding, and the opportunity to swim in the river added something special to the experience. Whether you are new to the practice or have previous experience, the course offers a welcoming environment in which to learn, reflect, and deepen your understanding.

name: Anonymous guest
text:
I’ve been working through a tough period and wanted to try something different to help me. While on the retreat, I quickly realised it was helping me work through healing so many more problems than I thought it might.

I wanted a soft introduction to Vipassana as a complete newbie to meditation. This was the perfect introduction. The setting was warm, stunning and soothing. All the glowing reviews are spot on!!

Within a few days, my breathing felt lighter, my IBS symptoms calmed down, and my body aches starting to lighten. This really calmed my mind and gave me some life lessons and skills to help me slow down and save myself from chronic disease!

name: Tracey
text:
It Was Wonderful!!

It was just amazing...don't hesitate, just go!!! Food 5 stars, teachers 5 stars. You will come back home renewed

name: Rosalind S.
text: Sublime mini retreat in a beautiful setting . Great yoga session to start , followed by a session in the sauna and a dip in the river. The piece de resistance was the fantastic meal created / cooked by Karen. Just a perfect day

name: Lucy
text: This was a really beautiful experience. Extremely well thought out programme and well organised. Beautiful food that supported our yoga experience. I met some like minded people and by day 2, I felt changed and greatly slowed down. The most memorable time for me was when we were practising yoga outside on the last morning and the sun came over the trees and started to warm us. One of the best yoga practises I can remember too. This weekend really gave what I needed and much more. Thank you lovely people!

name: Kirstie
text:
A very special healing experience

I felt in need of something nourishing and some real self-care. 

This retreat was the only one I found that is so close to nature & has a wonderful combination of yoga, Ayurvedic food & wisdom, and sweat lodge ceremony. 

By the end of the retreat, I felt absolutely rested, relaxed, calm, peaceful, nurtured & nourished. 

The organizers of this retreat are genuinely special & wonderful people, and the location feels really blessed.

Every element of the retreat, from the Ayurvedic food to the yoga, meditation, opening & closing ceremonies, writing workshop, and sweat lodge, embodied care & love and brought a different kind of healing.

I can't recommend this retreat enough :)

name: Anonymous guest
text:
My Review

I wanted to reconnect with meditation processes.

I chose it because it was affordable, in nature, and in silence.

Difficult to say what my accomplishments are as yet, as a lot of other life situations have taken over, but it certainly made me remember my practices, which were excellent, and now need some work to be restored

name: Anonymous guest
text:
Please Continue What You Do

I needed to reset my life, needed a change, back to nature. 

This retreat gave me all that I needed :) 

On the 1st day of introduction, I could feel immediate trust in the team. Following their experiences, organised with perfect details within a peaceful and calm dream come true environment/ settings. 

It's not what you want, but what you need. 

Please continue what you do :) Thank you to all, and sending loooooots of love

name: Anonymous guest
text:
You Always Have The Freedom To Let Go

I wanted to give myself a challenge and explore my self-concept. I wasn't the sort who would do this before.

I chose this retreat because it was one of the first I saw and turned out to be local.

I now use the tools every day, and I feel the change immediately. The knowledge that I can allow myself to experience intense focus.

You may realise that you always have the freedom to let go.

name: Anonymous guest
text:
Transformational

I like resetting my 'head' once or twice a year.

I chose it for the location, program and to learn more about Vapassana.

The highlight was the breathing - rise and fall and letting go.

The food is amazing, the environment is superb; the river, sauna, and therapists were also brilliant.

name: Alex G.
text:
A Transformative Experience

I was overworked, burnt out, stressed, depressed, and never switched off properly.

I chose it for the silence and meditation practice.

I gained a true mindset shift with new habits formed.

Karen, Dmitry, David & the whole team were incredible! Will be back!

name: Anonymous guest
text:
Retreat in The Most Beautiful British Countryside, with Incredible Teachers and People

Big birthdays always signal time passing and to reconsider life, which may lead to confusion and anxiety; this is what happened to me.

I chose this retreat because it is in the UK, only 2 hours away from London, in a beautiful location, doing the full 7-day Vipassana ritual in silence.

I was able to experience how to live in the present, something that truly must be experienced in order to be able to comprehend this state of being and to comprehend the truth behind sayings such as "years and decades are only mental constructs".

name: Viv
text:
Open The Eye Of Your Mind

I wanted to experience a sweat lodge. The tent was packed out, seriously hot, and intensely emotional for me. I was not expecting to feel close to my ancestors ... but I did!

I came home with some amazing memories. I have been all over the world but found deep cultural immersion on my doorstep, largely due to our leader and singer in the sweat lodge. He takes the responsibility of passing on the teachings of native americans very seriously. I felt it was an honor to be guided through the ritual by him.

Take earplugs to soften the nocturnal snoring from nearby tents.

name: Vanessa
text:
I wanted to learn more about Ayurvedic nutrition and lifestyle.

To learn how to adopt discipline in my mentality and to overcome certain yogic challenges.

It seemed like the most authentic and nonjudgemental training I had ever encountered, and previous reviews were glowing regarding the entire retreat and the teachers.

I definitely felt challenged and the training showed me where/ what I needed to focus on.

I felt totally emersed in the experience and will definitely return to do another.

I also recommend this beautiful place and unbelievable teachers to anyone interested in this subject and training.

name: Kevin
text:
I needed a reterat after being in 'work work work' mode.

I liked connecting with nature. 

Took myself outside of my comfort zone. 

Great all-round, really lovely people, setting, experience.

Felt welcomed and loved 🙏

name: Dawid
text:
Life Changing Retreat

I reached the point were too many life difficulties and challenges started piling up with too much stress and anxiety I couldn't bear it any longer. 

A retreat can give you the time you really need to disconnect from everyday life and see a different perspective. 

After the retreat, positive events started to unfold in my life, everything started to "click" perfectly into place.

I started regular mediation practice, my marriage got back on tracks, family relationship and work improved dramatically.

I can't praise the retreat and organisers enough, attending the event was a life changing experience.

Dmitri, Karen and a team are really passionate about what they do and you can feel their love every single day of a retreat and I am so grateful for meeting them all and attending retreat.

name: Rosalind
text: It's my second time at this yoga festival. I found this long weekend totally, fulfilling physically and mentally. We got up at sunrise for silent medition and then joining the wild swim group for a tranquil swim, followed by yoga, all before breakfast, was the perfect start to the day. The location is perfect, the food locally grown and auvedic, the walks, yoga wild swims and fire side chats and chants where all sublime. I'll definitely be back. Thank you go beyond x

name: Sarah
text: A beautiful experience in scenic surroundings. Great to meet such an amazing and welcoming group of people. The musicians are incredible, so talented and open in their expressions. The workshops are run with humility, kindness and compassion and are joy to experience. The food is incredible, a delight to the senses and palette. The therapist are intuitive and highly skilled, supporting the body and mind in what it needs in that moment. The sauna area was a pleasure to experience and held with love and kindness. Thank you to all who made this experience possible, the amazing volunteers alongside the organisers, facilitator's and all attendees. A beautifully held compassionate environment.

name: Emma
text: This was my second time to Hardwick. Once again it was lovely experience. Dmitri and Karen are fabulous hosts. Their gentle passion has created a beautiful, welcoming space for everyone. Thank you!

name: Craig
text:
A Wonderful Experience....

I've consistently meditated for a Decade or so, and Many times books and YouTube videos always said that meditation retreats are a MUST...

I loved the location and the disciplined approach to everything.

I have now implemented keeping as absolutely STILL as possible during my meditations. Something I strongly noted from our teachers, they sat like STATUES... 

Overall, a wonderful experience, I will certainly go on another retreat ASAP ...

name: Julie
text:
Vipassana and Me

I needed a massive reset on my chaotic life.

The solitary element. The rest it gave me from my busy mind

I no longer vape. I do not bite my fingernails. Odd outcome did not expect. I am calmer and less reactive.

It’s one of the hardest things I have ever done. But if you allow and trust the schedule, you will get results. DO NOT GIVE UP

Thank you all the team. I will do more of these types of retreats.

name: Spim
text:
Congratulations! You've Found It.

It was time to level up. Been meditating daily for 5 years and the calling was strong to dedicate even more time to my practice.

I asked myself 'What do I want?'. The answer was 'a river & lots of green trees'. There was an added bonus of the site being near where I was born. What I liked most about the retreat was the care and support that were present as we worked through our practice. The space was held most excellently!

I reached a depth of meditation that I hadn't reached before without using any plant medicine. I'm currently living totally medication-free! For the first time in many years, upon awakening in the morning, I'm keen to get started on the day, rather than lingering in my bed! Very energised!

If you want to 'sort your sh1t out!' this is the place to do it. Don't think. Just act. Book your place and commit to your own development. The time is now! I 100% endorse this retreat with all my heart and gratitude.

name: Kian
text:
Best Week on my Life, in Terms of Personal Development

There was no particular problem in my life, I just wanted to expand my knowledge of meditation.

I chose this retreat because my life was quite busy and I felt like a week of silence would do me some good. I loved this retreat because it was so brilliantly setup, from the outstanding good to the incredible teachings, we had all the steps in place to make the most of the meditations.

This week was honestly the best week I have had in my life, in terms of personal development. I have been meditating for 3 years, for 30 minutes every day. But I have never learnt some of the techniques and teachings that I was taught on this retreat. I come out of this retreat feeling mentally clearer and ready to take on any challenges in life going forward. It was truly life-changing.

If you have been thinking about doing a silent vipasanna retreat, I highly recommend it and I’d go with this particular one, as the team is incredibly supportive and friendly.

name: S W.
text:
It Could Have Been Better!
Tried to charge me more than the advertised amount when I went to pay on WeTravel. Given a tent with no bed. Agreed to just having a mattress. Unknown person/people entered my tent without permission whilst I was in a meditation session. Couldn't hear anything the teacher said from where I was sitting.  No food other than bananas and apples on the first morning of the retreat Spoken to rudely and in an aggressive manner upon arrival - 'don't chug down others' drinks etc.' by the organiser. She is very full on and like a sergeant major. Others I spoke to that evening felt similarly. No provision for hot weather - and it was boiling. Told not to leave other than during a meditation session so others wouldn't know I'd left. Book Retreats contacted the organisers on my behalf asking for a full refund but they refused. They also denied any of the above! It is now all in the hands of my credit card provider who has intervened and will be seeking a full refund on the 19th. I've been on numerous other silent retreats - none like this! I left as soon as I could so.. That not everything is as it appears to be.

name: Elizabeth
text:
Amazing Experience

I went to deepen my meditation skills.

I chose it because it was near home.

I gained great skill and understanding in meditation

Amazing experience all round. Highly recommend.

name: Tina
text:
It Was Quite Amazing

I needed silence to hear myself and cut out all the noise after an inward healing journey. Lethargy and procrastination were daily issues.

I chose it for the location and value for money. I wanted silence in beautiful nature, away from the noise of the ‘real’ world.

My accomplishment where that I could wake up early and spend my days with no distractions, even reading.
I didn’t even think about my phone and didn’t feel homesick because, quite simply, we were encouraged not to think! It was quite amazing.

Eating just two meals a day and eating after midday was unexpectedly easy too, and I felt my body thanked me.

name: Mark D.
text: Great experience and great food

name: Ellen
text: I wanted to challenge myself

name: Anonymous guest
text: I chose it because I wanted silence and space in nature.

name: Ruth F.
text: It was a very special experience. Amazingly beautiful venue, kind, friendly and interest g hosts. The yoga was excellent , I felt very energised after the practice. An amazing sauna followed , beautifully situated , nestled among trees and at a perfect temperature. A refreshing swim in the River Thames which at this point in its journey is narrow enough to swim from bank to picturesque bank. And finally a glorious home cooked cordon bleu vegan meal which looked as beautiful as it tasted . I was literally healed by the visit, having felt on the verge of a head cold for a day or so , I left the retreat feeling clear , relaxed and well. Thank you so much Dmitry and Karen for a lovely day!

name: Priya H.
text: Wonderful weekend with a group of fabulous people, the most beautiful location, great music, an enlightening foray into Ayurveda and Yoga and superlative food. As a foodie, I can’t praise Karen’s culinary skills enough! Thank you Dmitri, Karen and the extended team who made this so special 🙏🏽

name: Julia J.
text: This was a really special retreat, expert Ayurvedic knowledge was shared with true passion, the land itself is incredible - like a fairytale setting. The food was mind-blowing and created with such love. The pranayama and yoga mornings were excellent for self development and also just enjoyment and deep awakening. Thank you Dmitry and Karen for creating such a beautiful programme! I look forward to joining again.

name: Amanda B.
text: This does exactly what it says on the tin- Reset and Restore. Just arriving at the stunning estate and any tensions began to melt away. The breathwork session with Dimitry was hugely informative and effective. We felt empowered to be able to use the techniques at home for instant grounding and felt equally energised yet at peace. Being able to use the sauna and then jump in the glorious Thames was an indescribable joy and it was easy to lose yourself in the moment with the sun sparkling on the water - such a deep sense of presence and peace. In fact the only thing worth moving from that spot was the allure of Karen’s food and it was certainly worth moving for. It was obvious from the feeling around that beautifully laid dinner table that everyone had experienced a profound feeling of peace, and sitting in the gorgeous dining room with a view out across the fields down to the river in which we had just been immersed elevated the whole dining experience immeasurably. The food most definitely matched if not surpassed the build up. Karen’s passion shone through not only in the presentation and taste but in the explanation of why she had chosen what to make and the Ayurvedic principles behind that. We felt nourished on so many levels and will most definitely be back.

name: Clare M.
text: We had such a wonderful time on this retreat. From the minute we arrived everyone was so friendly. The camp itself really well organised giving people the option to mix or just go and do their own thing at quiet times. The activities were delivered in a beautiful, calm and relaxing way. The food was delicious! Always plenty and really varied. This is the first retreat I have been on and I have to say it really was one of the most amazing and enchanting experiences I have ever had. It felt so good to go back to basics and just stop and take in the world around me. Would highly recommend to anyone considering booking.

name: Diana C.
text: My forever grateful thanks for a wonderfully inclusive and nurturing weekend. Karen, your food was so nutritious and delicious. A weekend with expert teachers, guides and musicians. I feel fully rested,invigorated and restored in just 2 days. My heartfelt thanks to you all. See you next year.

name: Rachel L.
text: Really heartfelt experience with a group of profound souls. The teaching was deep, the food delicious and the land ancient and welcoming. Highly recommended as a genuine reset and recharge from city life. Thank you.

name: Johanna
text: I took part in the 7-day silent retreat with Sadhama, and it was a truly life changing experience. Vipassana is a Pali word that stands for 'clear-seeing' or 'insight'. Having previously heard about the 7 to 10-day meditation challenge, I never seriously considered that this would be something I'd ever venture into. Life has different plans. When my partner accidentally stumbled upon one right at our doorstep, with an element of yoga and sauna (!) incorporated into it, I began to feel the calling, and my excuses started to gently evaporate. After all, for the first time in over three years, I could go offline for a week without the sky falling, so what was stopping me? So, for the entirety of last week, I spent on a field, in silence, with 50 others who had made this strange commitment to their own evolution. The days began at 4.30 in the morning with the gong, and continued until 9 pm in the evening paced with 45-minute segments of both sitting and walking meditation. The instructions were plain, and the outcome clear: understand the nature of the mind and, as a result, the reality you live in, or, the reality you create for yourself as a result of your relationship to your mind. There was no dinner, and the first two days rained pretty much constantly. At the point where nearly all my essential items were starting to be pretty soaked, the sun made an appearance. "See, your vision is clearing, and as a result, the weather!" - we were told. Funnily, this was true. The first few days were hard. Once we passed the halfway mark, things started to feel lighter. The meditations finally began to feel like "they should." I wouldn't have been able to do this without the amazing lead of the incredible dharma teacher Dmitry, whose stoic wisdom truly drilled into our superficially suffering minds why this knowledge is so essential. --- Who do you want to run your life? For the first three days, I found my thoughts to be utterly insufferable; superficial, gimmicky, frantic, and judgmental. After three days, I began to notice the impact of the meditations where my thoughts began to rise at a slower pace and became easier to tame. By the completion of the retreat, I found myself to be in a foreign space of peaceful contentment. After finally being able to speak for the first time in seven days, I found a deep kinship with my fellow meditators. We had already shared so much, albeit without words. The retreat organizers incorporated a sharing session to the last night, and I cannot describe the feeling of seeing your mute fellow beings come into light and share their reasons for stepping onto the path of such deep self-inquiry and discipline. We laughed, and we cried hearing each other's shares. Traditional Vipassana is arranged in an exactly same way as Buddhist monks would practice in a monastery. The practice is simple, elegant, and challenging. In the West, we build our lives around our wishes and desires, our comforts and pleasantries. Unfortunately, as a result, we become evermore trapped in cycles of dependency when we no longer reign our own beings, but rather are pulled by our minds along like helpless children. Most people don't ever even consider doing anything to overcome the madness of their own minds, but as the Buddhist know so well, what results is an endless cycle of suffering. Vipassana invites us to first witness our internal havoc, and secondly, take charge by quieting the mind and repeatedly bringing ones' awareness to the present moment. Most importantly, there are no shortcuts, no tricks one can pull to make the process any easier. Belief in your own capacity and your constant commitment to the practice are the main tools on your path to lighter reality. After returning home, I've felt an amazing sense of calm stability, gratitude, and focus. I feel that my time has been extended, my mind is at rest, and I've experienced a long needed reset, which put me right back on my tracks. I feel called to learn more and to find a way to give back, now that I've had the opportunity to receive this knowledge that so many people go without for all their lives. We all can alleviate suffering, in our own lives, and in the lives of others, and I'd warmly recommend starting with the mess of your own mind. God knows we need more sane people in this insane world. Sadhamayoga, you've helped me more than I can express 🙏🙏🙏 The care that went into the food, space holding, and the treatments was palpable, and I left with my heart full of gratitude that people like you exist. May all beings be safe, free, and happy.

name: Sarah
text: Dmitry and Karen from Sadhama were fantastic hosts, Dmitys knowledge of the land is insightful and enlightening, and Karen’s food is exceptional, I felt very welcome and cared for. I would highly recommend

name: Kim
text: Relaxing, spacious, nourishing, fun, insightful, connecting, well organised.

name: Nicola
text: This was such a great weekend i dont even know where to begin. The Hardwick estate is just gorgeous and the campsite was located right next to the river. We booked a bell tent and it was absolutely massive, you could easily have four or five people sleeping in one. The organisers were super welcoming and the retreat was beautifully and smoothly organised, i loved everything the music, the singing, swimming in the Thames, the food was epic also. I didnt use the sauna but it looked amazing also. By the end of the weekend i was so full with love and gratitude and have not felt this happy for a long time. My only downside, it ended way too soon.

name: Karen
text: This was a wonderful weekend. Too many moments to mention and laughter, relaxation and joy in abundance. The food was superb and the teachers were wonderful. I learned so much, met some wonderful people and came back feeling refreshed and restored and with lots to think about. Perfect! Thanks so very much and I will definitely be back.

name: Emma
text: I felt very safe and held on this retreat. Everyone was made to feel part of the community. The food was amazing. The scenery was beautiful. Whilst I did not join in every activity, I was never made to feel uncomfortable. I will definitely return. Thank you.

name: Harvey
text: I really beautiful place to camp, enjoy yoga and wonderful food. A perfect escape in contact with nature.

name: Leanne
text: This is my 3rd trip to hardwick estate and it honestly is the most magical place. I have come away feeling relaxed calm and grounded. The food is so nourishing and absolutely delicious. The activities and yoga were perfect and at moments very profound. The morning swim was particularly wonderful! The connections made during the trip will be cherished in my heart forever. I've made some life long friends from attending these retreats over the past few years. To top it off we slept in the pre-erected bell tent which was a great experience.. very unique, stress free and comfortable (slept so well :-). Thankyou everyone who made the retreat so joyful and the time and love that the organisers put in to making it so special. I highly recommend the retreats to anyone who wants to find that inner calm/peace and a break from the hectic world- the land and energy of community is really is a slice of heaven. Love Gratitude and blessings

name: Grace
text: I had THE most magical weekend. I feel so connected to practice and nature and trees since. I’m truly missing being able to walk 2 mins to dip into the beautiful lake. My skin, mind, soul feels so different. Thank you Phil for your beautiful yoga practice - I have been doing it almost every day since and you’ve inspired me so much to connect back with my yoga practice. My love for it feels re-born. Thank you Dimitry for connecting us back into ourselves, & the elements. I see trees so differently now! Thank you Nathan for the beautiful workshop - for the last week I have imagined kissing the earth with my feets and using the 2 bells. So lovely. Thank you to all the beautiful musicians. Thank you for opening my mind up to understanding Ayurveda foods. Thank you for all the souls I got to connect with, sing with, dance with, play with and share with. I feel very inspired and connected back to myself & practice.

name: Elaine
text: My time on the five day immersion surpassed my wildest dreams.... as a single older woman who hadn't camped for years I felt I needed to stretch myself, move into my new rearranged body as a free woman. I gathered the equipment and arrived in blazing sunshine very apprehensive, swallowed hard and dived into the Thames after I had set myself up in the field. I did not look back, it felt as if the five days had been designed to give me just what I needed. The warmth, heart felt support and love...oodles of it just flowed through me. We just were, the level of energy and inner light was intoxicating. I had such a great time, the food, the way the programmed just flowed and supported us, the amazing treatments, Massage and Kinesiology worked deep and complimented all that I was taking in. The wonderful gathering of souls from many walks of life, bringing their individual talents. The music, ceremonies, level of enthusiasm and commitment by everyone in all we experienced. Thank you so, so much.

name: Eve
text: Vipassana retreat - Beautiful location, amazing people, and just an overall wonderful experience. Dimitri’s teachings were grounded and relatable. Karen’s food was delicious and nourishing. And the whole crew made the space feel so safe and comfortable. If you’re thinking about going, do it! You may discover something here that can change your life

name: Tracy E.
text:
A wonderful synergy of location - beautiful countryside, woodland walks, and the river to swim in- with yoga classes,  informative and profound teachings delivered with lightness and humour and guided meditations along with delicious nourishing food make for a truly peaceful, uplifting and recharging retreat centre.
Dimitri and Karen make a great team along with a small army of happy helpers.
I attended the 3 night silent and phone free peace retreat and loved it. Would definitely recommend!
